variables.name: framesPerBlock
variables.comment: Number of frames per block of the input (yet to be decoded) data.

variables.name: inputData
variables.comment: Target for the input (yet to be decoded) data.

variables.name: decodedData
variables.comment: Target for decoded (yet to be output) data.

variables.name: targetSampleSizeFrames
variables.comment: The target size of each output sample, in frames.

variables.name: pendingInputBytes
variables.comment: The number of pending bytes in {@link #inputData}.

variables.name: startTimeUs
variables.comment: The time at which the writer was last {@link #reset}.

variables.name: pendingOutputBytes
variables.comment:
* The number of bytes that have been written to {@link #trackOutput} but have yet to be
     * included as part of a sample (i.e. the corresponding call to {@link
     * TrackOutput#sampleMetadata} has yet to be made).

variables.name: outputFrameCount
variables.comment:
* The total number of frames in samples that have been written to the trackOutput since the
     * last call to {@link #reset}.
